data.body_html:
Watching the NYE 2033 fireworks from a private boat in Marbella is one of the most memorable ways to welcome the new year. Instead of battling crowds along the Golden Mile or jostling for a table at a Puerto Banús restaurant, you can anchor 200 metres off the breakwater with a glass of cava in hand. Our fleet of 18 boats departs from Puerto Banús, and every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and Spanish IVA. Here is everything you need to plan your perfect Marbella boat rental for NYE 2033 fireworks.

Why Watch the NYE 2033 Fireworks from a Boat?

The Puerto Banús fireworks display is launched from the breakwater at midnight. From the water, you get an unobstructed 180° view of the sky above the marina, the reflections on the sea, and the entire coastline lit up. No queues, no noise restrictions, and you control the playlist. The average December sea temperature in Marbella is 16 °C, so bring a jacket, but the boat’s cabin stays warm. The experience is exclusive yet surprisingly affordable: a 4-hour charter on the Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) costs €749 all-in.

Best Boats for NYE Fireworks Viewing

For maximum comfort during the evening, choose a boat with a flybridge or a spacious aft deck. Here are the top picks for a Marbella boat rental NYE 2033 fireworks experience:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m, 12 pax) – The flybridge seats 8 with 360° views, a wet bar, and a bimini top for light rain protection.
  • Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax) – Open-plan saloon with sliding doors to the deck; includes a free jet ski for daytime add-ons (€4,719/4h).
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) – Best value at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Cosy cockpit with a table for snacks.
  • Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax) – The flagship: three decks, a jacuzzi, and a full crew. Pricing on request.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús and return by 01:30. The crew will position the vessel bow-first toward the fireworks so the cockpit stays sheltered.

Where to Anchor for the Best View

The fireworks launch from the western end of Puerto Banús breakwater. The ideal anchorage is 200–400 m directly in front of the breakwater, between the marina entrance and the Cala del Faro headland. This spot is shallow enough (8–12 m depth) for a secure anchor, yet far enough to see the full display. The skipper knows the exact GPS coordinates from previous NYE charters. If you prefer a quieter setting, anchor off the Cabopino dunes – you will see the fireworks slightly smaller but with the entire Marbella skyline behind them.

What’s Included in Your NYE Charter

Every Marbella boat rental for NYE 2033 fireworks includes:

  • Licensed English- and Spanish-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full cruise and return
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava (enough for your group)
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, and canapés)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

You are welcome to bring your own food and decorations. The crew will help set up a small table for your party. Note that glass bottles are discouraged for safety; use plastic or cans if possible.

Sample NYE Itinerary

A typical 4-hour charter runs from 22:30 to 02:30. Here is how the evening unfolds:

  • 22:30 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.
  • 22:45 – Depart the marina. Cruise east toward Marbella Marina to see the Golden Mile lights.
  • 23:30 – Return to the anchorage off the breakwater. Crew drops anchor and serves snacks.
  • 00:00 – Fireworks begin. Toast with cava as the sky explodes.
  • 00:15 – Fireworks end. Music continues; enjoy the afterglow.
  • 01:00 – Weigh anchor and cruise back to Puerto Banús.
  • 01:30 – Dock and disembark.

For a longer evening, choose the 6-hour charter (€1,499 on Tier A boats) and include a stop at Cala Cortés for a midnight swim (water temperature is brisk but invigorating).

Booking Tips for NYE 2033

Marbella boat rental for NYE 2033 fireworks is in high demand. Book by 15 December 2033 to secure your preferred boat and time. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability – we respond within 2 hours. A 50% deposit holds the slot; the balance is due 14 days before departure. If weather forces cancellation, you receive a full refund or can reschedule. For groups larger than 12, we can charter two boats that raft together during the fireworks.

Consider adding a daytime cruise on 31 December to explore the coast from Estepona to Sotogrande. The Mangusta 80 (Grey) at €4,719/4h includes a jet ski for exploring coves. Then return to port, freshen up, and head out again for the evening fireworks. It is the ultimate NYE double-header.
